title: Hydrogen storage capacity, strain-improved formation enthalpy, desorption temperature, and high energy harvesting performance of SrGaH5
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,18612-18623
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09694D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Samia Shahzadi, A. Ibrahim, S. Nazir
We explore SrGaH5, focusing on its potential for hydrogen storage (HS) and various physical aspects via first-principles calculations under strain. Strain has a positive impact on its thermodynamics, enhancing its potential for use in HS.
